author: Inside Edition
description: Speculation is rampant over who will replace Karoline Leavitt. The 28-year-old White House Press Secretary made the surprising announcement that she is stepping down to focus on her two children. The names coming forward include White House Director of Communications Steven Cheung and Katie Miller, wife of President Trump’s close confidant, Stephen Miller.
title: Who Will Replace Karoline Leavitt As White House Press Secretary?

author: Inside Edition
description: One woman learned the hard way that making margaritas can sometimes take a terrible toll. Jewelry designer Haley Peacock tells Inside Edition she suffered  "margarita burn" after squeezing 30 limes while making a batch of the cocktails. She says she rinsed her hands and went out in the sun. Over the next five days, her hands developed large, painful blisters. The condition is known as phytophotodermatitis.
title: Woman Suffers 'Margarita Burn' On Her Hands

author: Inside Edition
description: Conspiracy theories are swirling around Patrick Clancy, the ex-husband of Lindsay Clancy, as her trial continues for the killing of her three children. On social media, posters are alleging he didn't do enough to help her. She has pleaded not guilty and says she was suffering from postpartum psychosis.
title: Conspiracy Theories Swirl Around Patrick Clancy

author: Inside Edition
description: An Amazon driver is warming hearts across the country for making a patriotic gesture. While walking away after her delivery, she noticed a U.S. flag coiled around itself. It took six tries to get it unfurled.  She then saluted it. Homeowner Ange Burnett was at work when she got an alert from her Ring camera showing the driver unfurling and saluting the flag. Inside Edition spoke with the delivery driver, Nativida Muhammad.
title: Delivery Driver Warms Hearts After Unfurling And Saluting US Flag

author: Inside Edition
description: Sometimes the most unlikely pair can bond and create a beautiful friendship. Which is the case at Six Flags Great Adventure in Jackson, New Jersey. A 2-month-old bison calf named Gertie and a year-old kangaroo named Penny have become the best of friends. The pair relax and play together, and Penny even grooms Gertie when she sees fit. Their friendship has caught the attention of the staff, who have enjoyed watching the pair every day. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Baby Kangaroo And Bison Have Become The Best Of Friends

author: Inside Edition
description: An American former Marine, imprisoned in Russia since 2022, has been returned to the United States. The State Department said Robert Gilman was released so he could travel home for medical treatment. Gilman, of Massachusetts,  was reportedly arrested in Russia for assaulting a police officer. He received a sentence of 10 years in prison, but advocates say the charges and the sentence were exaggerated for political purposes. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Russia Releases Robert Gilman, Ailing American Ex-Marine In Custody Since 2022

author: Inside Edition
description: A California mom frantically called 911 while she was driving when she realized her three-year-old son, who is autustic and nonverbal, was choking on vomit and not breathing.Officers rushed to the scene and captured their actions on bodycam footage on August 6. Now, nearly a week later, the boy and his mother got to thank the officers in person for saving the young child's life.
title: California Cops Rescue Autistic Toddler Choking on Vomit

author: Inside Edition
description: A family is calling for an investigation into the actions of an Arkansas State Trooper during this arrest on August 1st. Attorney Ben Crump is representing the arrestee, 18-year-old Alisa Hackett, who claims the trooper used excessive force to arrest her, including punching her in the face during the arrest. According to CBS News, Trooper Mossies Arellano claimed in a police report Hackett was resisting arrest. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Dashcam Video Shows Trooper Punch 18-Year-Old Woman In Face During Arrest

author: Inside Edition
description: The annual Loon Calling Contest in Belgrade Lakes, Maine, brings a raft of 'loon-atics' to make their best bird sounds.
title: Can You Tell The Loons From The Humans? #shorts
